recommendation.criterion: Preserve native form participation, reset behavior, autofill, names/values, and submit behavior; test controlled and uncontrolled variants.
basis: Retained accepted native form names/values, submitted values, grouped/external text-field resets and selector controlled/uncontrolled/reset flows are recorded by wave-04/05/retained-native-cases.json and its accepted-history report.
New full-Chromium native address-autofill cases pass for unmanaged baseline and all three SGUI host policies: uncontrolled, controlled accepting, controlled rejecting.

Each SGUI policy preserves callback requests, controlled authority, FormData, button and external Enter submit, silent accepted/canceled reset, form reassociation, readOnly/disabled exclusion and sibling isolation under unchanged assertions.
ComboBox canceled-reset draft/selected-key/callback correction is independently native-confirmed by combobox-chromium-reset-01; previous Firefox/WebKit passes remain retained.
limits: CDP native address autofill is tested. No saved-profile popup selection or password-manager interaction is claimed.
Full-Chromium only for Autofill-domain evidence; no Firefox/WebKit autofill claim.
No new actual spoken-AT, physical touch or browser zoom acceptance is inferred.
Coordinator owns closure decisions and count mutations. Historical failures remain preserved.
